# Testing Logistic Regression

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(krulRutils)


bound <- 10
partition_size <- 1000
x_data <- seq(-10, 10, length.out = partition_size)
y_data <- 1/(1 + exp(-x_data))

logistic_tbl <- tibble(
  x = x_data,
  y = y_data
)

logistic_plot <- logistic_tbl %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y)) + 
  geom_line(
    color = c_pal("C blue"),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Logistic function",
    x = "X",
    y = "Y"
  ) +
  theme_krul()

logistic_plot
    
```
